remarks: The seller is requesting highest and best offers by Tuesday at 3:00 PM.  Perched gracefully atop a scenic hill, this quintessential Connecticut home offers a rare blend of privacy, charm, and opportunity. Set among grand estates and located just two miles from the New Canaan train station, the setting alone is enough to capture your heart. This is an exceptional opportunity to reimagine and elevate a truly special property into your own masterpiece. The home features generously scaled rooms, beautiful hardwood floors, and a screened-in porch you may never wish to leave. A welcoming family room with a striking brick fireplace overlooks the serene, private backyard, creating the perfect space to unwind or entertain. The residence includes a spacious living room and dining room, a private office ideal for working from home, and a lovely primary suite with en-suite bath. Three additional bedrooms and a two-car garage complete the offering. Please refer to the floor plan for full layout details. Beyond the home, enjoy all that New Canaan has to offer, from award-winning restaurants and unique boutique shopping to top-rated schools, beautiful parks, and an Olympic-sized town pool. With Metro-North access, commuting to New York City is seamless. Adding to the charm, Lee Memorial Garden is just a short stroll away, offering breathtaking displays of azaleas and rhododendrons each spring. A rare setting, a special home, and an opportunity not to be missed... welcome home.
